text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan looks under the weather,
so I send
her to the infirmary to get
some rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I sincerely apologize for the trouble. I
shall lie
down for the time being...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I'm all too familiar with such
surroundings. It appears I'm to live my
life against the backdrop
of various
hospital rooms.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...That said, this time, I have someone
waiting for
me to race again. I must
recover fully.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What is this sensation? My body feels so
light...
And?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My legs are brimming with power! I've
never felt
like this before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
With these legs... I've no limits.
I can run
for as
long as I wish to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I want to run! Everywhere and anywhere!
And with
these legs...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It was but a fleeting dream. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It seems... dreams, too, can brighten
one's mood
from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps owing to some proper rest,
Mejiro Ardan
seems to have returned to
her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it's possible to dream within
dreams...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Mejiro Ardan has had plenty
of rest, she
still doesn't seem to be
feeling any better.
